summary.key_theme: 科技股近期面臨賣壓與市場情緒轉弱，投資人對於 AI 資本支出與總體經濟環境的擔憂加劇，導致 QQQ 短期技術面承壓。

bullish.title: Tech Stock Sell-Off: 1 Unstoppable ETF to Buy on the Dip in 2026
bullish.reason: 儘管近期科技股出現拋售，但分析師仍將 Invesco QQQ Trust 視為成長型投資人長期可靠的投資標的，建議投資人可逢低布局。

bullish.title: Double Size, Double Leverage: Why We Supercharged This QQQ Trade

bearish.title: Michael Burry's 'Red October' Warning: Why QQQ and SMH Could Face More Pain
bearish.reason: 知名投資人 Michael Burry 警告市場可能觸頂，指出即便債券殖利率下降也未能支撐科技股，暗示 QQQ 可能面臨進一步下跌風險。

bearish.title: 3 Reasons QQQ Could Fall 10% Soon, and 1 Reason It Could Rally Into 2027
bearish.reason: 文章詳細列舉了 QQQ 可能下跌 10 % 的三大理由，反映出市場對於科技股估值與動能減弱的深層擔憂。

bearish.title: Broad Selling Breaks the Fragile Recovery as Small Caps Sink
bearish.reason: 市場廣度轉為負面，且 QQQ 已跌破關鍵支撐位，顯示技術面趨勢轉弱，賣壓沉重。

bearish.title: Meta's AI Spending Could Hit $205 Billion in 2027: Why Magnificent 7 ETFs Face a Crucial Test

bearish.title: Health Care and Crude Led the Week While Tech Lost Its Grip
bearish.reason: 報導指出科技板塊近期表現疲軟，Invesco QQQ Trust 價格下跌，顯示資金正從科技股輪動至其他板塊。

bearish.title: QQQ: How To Set Up A Bear Put Spread In This Hot Tech Index
bearish.reason: 文章建議投資人建立賣權價差（Bear Put Spread）策略，顯示市場對 QQQ 短期走勢持看空態度。

neutral.title: Why Are Nasdaq Futures Falling Premarket? ... retail sentiment toward SPY has dipped into ‘bearish’ territory and has moderated to ‘neutral’ for QQQ.
neutral.reason: 零售投資人對 QQQ 的情緒轉為中性，顯示市場在經歷拋售後進入觀望階段。

neutral.title: QQQ vs. Cheaper Nasdaq-100 ETFs: Why BlackRock And State Street Aren't Winning Investors Yet
neutral.reason: 儘管 BlackRock 與 State Street 推出低成本競爭產品，但數據顯示 QQQ 仍保有市場優勢，資金流出有限，競爭格局暫未改變。
